verdicts.reason: A factors validation into small named helpers and constants (isValidLocalPart, isValidDomain, ageOn, named regexes) and passes already-validated values as optionals, whereas B inlines regexes, writes a long monolithic isValidEmail, and threads value-plus-boolean pairs (country/countryOk, email/emailOk) that are easier to misuse.

B replaces A's paired value-plus-boolean parameters (email/emailOk, country/countryOk) with optional values, names its regexes, and extracts small focused helpers like ageOn and isValidDomain, so each rule is easier to locate and change in isolation.
